<thought>To generate a silicon (1,1,1) slab, I will provide a complete CIF for bulk silicon (diamond cubic) that the slab tool can parse. Then I will enumerate slabs, select the first slab, retrieve the CO₂ molecule, identify adsorption sites, choose the specified ontop site (site_index 0), place CO₂ at the given height (2.0 Å), save the combined structure to a CIF file, and output its path.</thought>
<action>enumerate_slabs_text</action>
